author: jsign
content:
New zkEVM test release: [tests-zkevm@v21.0.1](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v21.0.1).

Some of the changes:
- `StatelessInput` and the Engine API witness response no longer include `pub_keys`, so guests don't get sender public keys anymore.
- A malformed storage leaf in the witness now fails validation instead of reading as zero.
- Some fixtures had `statelessInputBytes` for the wrong block. That's fixed, and RLP-modified blocks and Engine API payload fixtures now also include stateless input and output bytes. This means more coverage of invalid blocks.
- `consume engine-witness --ssz` now uses the new `/engine/v1/payloads/witness` SSZ endpoint.

Recommend seeing full [release description](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v21.0.1) which has more details and linked PRs.
Thanks a lot to Ömer for a quick double checking before announcing.
